article.title: ‘They destroy, we build’: Gazans rebuild their homes out of mud and rubble
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: As Israel continues to prevent the entry of reconstruction materials into Gaza, Palestinians rebuild their homes with salvaged rebar, recovered limestone, and clay. “This is the evidence of our love for our land,” Fayez Abu Shamala tells Mondoweiss.
